name: clinica-statistics-volume
description:
Volume-based mass-univariate analysis with SPM.

   GROUP_LABEL is an user-defined identifier to target a specific group of subjects.

   The type of volume-based feature can be defined by using the third argument: t1-volume to use gray matter maps, pet-volume to use PET data or custom-pipeline for you own data in CAPS directory.

   SUBJECT_VISITS_WITH_COVARIATES_TSV is a TSV file containing a list of subjects with their sessions and all the covariates and factors of the model.

   CONTRAST is a string defining the contrast matrix or the variable of interest for the GLM.

See https://aramislab.paris.inria.fr/clinica/docs/public/latest/Pipelines/Stats_Volume/

inputs.description: Name of the DARTEL template that Clinica needs to use to grab the input files. (Default: "*")
inputs.name: group_label_dartel

inputs.description: Full Width at Half Maximum (FWHM) of the smoothing used in your input files. (Default: 8)
inputs.name: full_width_at_half_maximum

inputs.description: Name of the label given to the PET acquisition, specifying the tracer used (acq-<acq_label>).
inputs.name: acq_label

inputs.description: Intensity normalization using the average PET uptake in reference regions resulting in a standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) map. It can be cerebellumPons (used for amyloid tracers) or pons (used for 18F-FDG tracers).
inputs.name: suvr_reference_region

inputs.description: Use PET data with partial value correction.
inputs.name: use_pvc_data

inputs.description: Custom file string. Specify filename using * when the subject or session name appears e.g. '*_trc-18FFDG_pet_space-Ixi549Space_pet.nii.gz' will grab the corresponding file in all the subjects/sessions. This flag must be specified with the --measure_label flag). See Wiki for an example.
inputs.name: custom_file

inputs.description: Name of the feature type, it will be saved on the CAPS _measure-MEASURE_LABEL key-value association. This flag must be specified with the --custom_file flag). See Wiki for an example.
inputs.name: measure_label

inputs.description: Temporary directory to store pipelines intermediate results.
inputs.name: working_directory

inputs.description: Number of cores used to run in parallel.
inputs.name: n_procs

inputs.description: Threshold to define a cluster in the process of cluster-wise correction. (Default: 0.001)
inputs.name: cluster_threshold
